prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was going through my notes from that Beijing trip in 2025—felt like I spent half the time just browsing random attractions in Beijing.
One day I ended up at Great Wall Badaling—honestly, it was the highlight, even though it was super crowded.
I still remember the ticket was for 2025-03-13, and they slotted me into the 16:00 entry time.
It was just me—visitor name Liu Yang—and I only needed one ticket, so it was pretty straightforward.
After that I kept bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai, and I remember comparing trains from Beijing to Shanghai with flights too, just out of curiosity.
For the flights, the route was Beijing to Shanghai, and my coworker mentioned a flight_id CA1234 for 2025-03-12—Chen Ming was the passenger name on that one.
Yeah, that booking wasn’t even under me—passenger_name was Chen Ming, and it was all already handled back then.

And on the train side, my friend Zhou Jun took the G3 on 2025-03-20 in First Class—around the same time I was also scrolling through course listings and he joked I should sign up for Drawing Fundamentals under Liu Yang's name.
